newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 5.62 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 5.62 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 5,623,200 lbs of frozen beef for use by the National School Lunch program and other food programs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-48 and be received by 1430 EDT in Washington, D.C., on Friday, November 1, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, November 8, 1996.
Shipments must be made between December 13 and 26, 1996, the AMS said.
